summary: Addendum v4.3 §1 Phase 1 (Sandbox pre-auth 60s evaluation) verified end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 PASS in new /app/backend/tests/test_sandbox_phase1.py covering POST /api/sandbox/generate (10 stages + company/sector/region substitution into stage[2] text, total_ms=60000, 422 on missing/invalid sector), GET /api/sandbox/generate/{id}/status (404 on unknown, flips 'generating'→'ready' within 8s, access_token surfaced only when ready), banking_midcap seed integrity (3 committees + 3 docs + 6 signals + 1 briefing, company name + KSh currency substituted into document text and briefing opening_paragraph, signals contain 'loan-loss coverage' / 'depositor concentration' / 'NPL' phrases), generic_diversified fallback (sector=other → 1 doc / 3 signals / 1 briefing), JWT auto-login (access_token works via Authorization: Bearer on /api/auth/me, account.name starts with 'Sandbox visitor', contexts[0].type='sandbox' and sandbox_metadata surfaced via sanitize_context), 14/21/22-day expiry window (expires_at≈+14d, read_only_until≈+21d, hard_delete_at≈+22d within ±5min tolerance), GET /api/sandbox/templates meta endpoint (financial_services→banking_midcap polished=true, saas→generic_diversified polished=false), cookie-auth regression (bramuel@syni.ai login still sets access_token cookie, /auth/me returns no sandbox contexts), and POST /api/sandbox/cleanup/expired sweeper. Frontend full arc verified on live preview: Landing hero-sandbox-btn ('Try AKKI in 60 seconds') → /sandbox intake → filled TEST_Neo Capital Partners + Financial services + NED + East Africa → /sandbox/generating/<id> (sandbox-generating-company renders 'Creating TEST_Neo Capital Partners…', sandbox-progress + sandbox-stage-* testids present) → auto-navigates to /app within ~10s → sandbox-banner renders above top-bar with exact spec text 'Sandbox — you are exploring fictional data for TEST_Neo Capital Partners. 14 days remaining. Ready to use AKKI on your real data? Set up your account →', sandbox-banner-days='14 days remaining', sandbox-banner-convert link present. Banking keywords (NPL, loan-loss, depositor) present in /app body. Cream/oxblood/Georgia design preserved; /sandbox intake has no AppShell chrome; generating page is centered on empty cream canvas as specified. Zero console errors apart from expected pre-login 401 on /auth/me while on the pre-auth /sandbox page.

minor.issue: sanitize_account() in core.py does not surface is_sandbox (or sandbox_session_id). The backing account doc has is_sandbox=true (verified directly in Mongo), but the field is stripped by sanitize_account. Frontend currently relies on contexts[0].type==='sandbox' to decide whether to show the banner — works today, but if any future client code wants to key off account.is_sandbox it will silently see undefined.

sandbox_artefact=true flag is stored on every seeded artefact in Mongo (verified) but is not surfaced in the list/detail API responses — the response sanitizer drops unknown keys. Spec says 'All artefacts carry sandbox_artefact=true'. Fine if it's purely a server-side audit marker; worth surfacing if the frontend ever needs to tag sandbox-seeded rows differently from user-uploaded ones.

integration_issues.issue: Home tabs show 'Top signals 0 · Top briefings 0 · New documents 0' immediately after landing, even though the banking_midcap template has seeded 6 signals, 3 docs, and 1 briefing into the context (all reachable via GET /api/contexts/{cid}/signals etc., and keywords NPL/loan-loss/depositor are present elsewhere on the page). The Home aggregation surfaces likely exclude sandbox_artefact=true or otherwise filter on uploaded_by activity windows. Not a blocker for the conversion arc (banner + signals tab both work), but the first impression of a 'quiet workspace' undercuts the 'wow moment' the sandbox is designed to deliver.

issues: First option ('Financial services (banking, asset mgmt, insurance, fintech)') is present in the DOM with role=option but is rendered above the visible panel scroll region — a user opening the dropdown sees the list starting at 'SaaS / Technology' and has to scroll up to discover Financial services. This is the ONE polished Phase-1 template and should be the first visible option. Likely an initial scrollTop of the Radix/shadcn Select — set listbox scrollTop=0 on open, or mark Financial services with defaultChecked.

action_items: Fix /sandbox Q2 sector dropdown: on open, the listbox should scroll to the top so 'Financial services' (the only polished Phase-1 template) is the first option a prospect sees.

Investigate why Home surface inside a sandbox shows 0 signals / 0 briefings / 0 documents despite the banking_midcap template seeding 6/1/3 — aggregation filter is likely hiding sandbox_artefact rows or the created_at window excludes the freshly-seeded (but back-dated) artefacts. Tuli/Mawingu/Safiri non-sandbox contexts are fine.
(Minor) Surface is_sandbox on sanitize_account and sandbox_artefact on document/signal/briefing sanitizers so the frontend can key off them without a DB round-trip.

(Polish) Consider making the sandbox seed artefacts' created_at distribute across the last 7 days rather than clustered in the last 24h so the 'recent activity' filters on Home pick them up immediately.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/sandbox.py — clean 316 lines, single-purpose. Good separation: intake validation via pydantic literals, async background seed via asyncio.create_task, in-memory session store is fine for the ≤60s session window (documented).

routers/sandbox.py::_seed_sandbox swallows failures into s['error'] but does NOT delete the account/context/memberships created before the exception — if seeding fails mid-flight the orphaned account (is_sandbox=true, default_context_id pointing at a half-seeded context) will live until the next hard_delete sweep. Add a try/except-with-rollback.

routers/sandbox.py::generate_status — returns access_token only when status=='ready', good. But access_token is then held in _sessions forever (until process restart). Consider clearing _sessions[sid] on first successful poll where ready=true OR after a TTL (e.g. 60s post-ready) to avoid a slow memory leak under heavy sandbox traffic.

routers/sandbox.py::cleanup_expired_sandboxes — no auth guard. OK per inline comment, but consider at minimum an internal shared-secret header before production traffic, since a hostile caller can DOS Mongo deletes by repeatedly posting this (it's cheap when there's nothing to sweep, but enumeration / timing side-channels still exist).

sandbox_service.py — 580 lines; fine today because ~350 of those are embedded template content strings. Once templates 2-8 ship (next sprint), split the templates into sandbox_service/templates/<sector>.py and keep sandbox_service.py as the dispatcher.

sandbox_service.py::resolve_stage_texts — stage templates use {role_label}, {sector_label}, {region_label}, {company_name}; missing-key KeyError is caught and falls back to the raw template. Good defensive default but silently serves '{company_name}' to the user in the fallback path. Add a logger.warning.
core.py::sanitize_account does not include is_sandbox/sandbox_session_id. Minor — add them behind a conditional so non-sandbox accounts don't surface a useless `is_sandbox: false`.
core.py::sanitize_context already includes sandbox_metadata — confirmed in tests, good.
Home surface data layer (not reviewed deeply) apparently filters out the freshly-seeded artefacts. Action item above.

Test credentials for sandbox: disposable accounts use sandbox+<session_id>@akki.local with a secrets.token_urlsafe(16) password never exposed. Access is via JWT only. Good — no attack surface via password reset flows.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 iter13 sandbox tests PASS — generate+stages+substitutions, status 404/ready flip, banking seed integrity 3+3+6+1, generic fallback 1+3+1, bearer /auth/me auto-login, 14/21/22-day expiry window, templates meta endpoint, bramuel cookie-auth regression, cleanup sweeper)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the spec'd arc — hero-sandbox-btn ('Try AKKI in 60 seconds') → /sandbox → all 4 testids filled → /sandbox/generating/<id> (sandbox-generating-company + sandbox-progress + sandbox-stage-* present) → /app with sandbox-banner (exact spec copy + sandbox-banner-days '14 days remaining' + sandbox-banner-convert link). Banking keywords present in /app body. No console errors other than expected pre-login 401 on /auth/me at /sandbox.

test_credentials: Sandbox is credential-less. Regression leg uses bramuel@syni.ai / TestBramuel2026! from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Tests created 4 TEST_-prefixed sandbox contexts (TEST_Neo Capital Partners ×2, TEST_Neo Banking Plc, TEST_Quick Ready, TEST_Diversified Holdings), 4 disposable sandbox+<id>@akki.local accounts, ~10 seeded docs, ~20 seeded signals, ~4 seeded briefings. Not cleaned up automatically — POST /api/sandbox/cleanup/expired is a no-op because hard_delete_at is ~22 days out. Main agent may sweep by back-dating sandbox_metadata.hard_delete_at on the test contexts, or leave them — they're scoped to disposable email accounts and won't pollute real user sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_sandbox_phase1.py -v. All 12 should pass in ~4s. BASE_URL is read from /app/frontend/.env via python-dotenv. Two minor sanitizer gaps noted (is_sandbox not on /auth/me.account, sandbox_artefact not on document/signal/briefing list responses) — DB values are correct; only the API projection is missing the flag. If the main agent fixes those, assertions like `me['account'].get('is_sandbox') is True` and `all(d.get('sandbox_artefact') for d in docs_list)` can be re-enabled in the test file (currently commented out with a note). Design-layer follow-up: the sector Select starts scrolled past 'Financial services' — tracked as action item. Home surface inside a sandbox shows zero aggregated signals/docs/briefings despite the context having them — the seeded artefact created_at values (now-24h..now-21h for docs, now-30m..now-20m for signals, now-10m for briefing) should fall inside any sensible 'recent' window, so the filter is likely on a different field (e.g. uploaded_by matches a human user, not the sandbox owner). Worth one pass by the main agent.
rca of the issue: No critical issues. The one UX gap on Home ('0 signals / 0 briefings / 0 documents' in a freshly-seeded sandbox) is worth a code-layer dive next sprint — this is the exact moment the prospect should see the wow-factor, and the banner + signals tab both work, but Home is the default landing surface inside /app and it says 'Your workspace is quiet. Upload a pack…' which is the opposite of what the sandbox is selling.
